title: Ben Kufya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman relates from Midrash Tehillim 9:3 that when the government decreed Rabbi Yehudah the Baker’s death, Ben Kufya wished to save him. The government learned of it and decreed that he too be killed. Hyman calls the Bar Kappara reading in the old Midrash Tehillim an error, which misled Va’ad Chakhamim 4a. That work wondered why Bar Kappara was not counted among those executed by the government.

notes.text: Hyman’s old-Midrash-Tehillim reading, criticism of Va’ad Chakhamim and explanation of the error remain his reports. Saved digital text does not establish their printing history.

The consulted ordinary Midrash Tehillim 9:14 names Bar Kappara in the rescue narrative. A directly inspected Yalkut Shimoni Psalms 643 parallel names Ben Kufya. This comparison does not establish the exact Midrash Tehillim edition behind Hyman’s 9:3 locator, or prove that Ben Kufya and Bar Kappara are the same person.
